reviews.text:
Excellent and professional service.
Friendly and knowledgeable. Highly, highly recommended.
We had a great experience, highly recommended. Our furry friend was in very good hands. Thank you for your excellent care.

I couldn't be more grateful. I came all the way from Alicante because I know Happy is in the best hands. From the very first moment, they have cared for Happy with so much love, professionalism, and patience. In times of worry, finding someone so dedicated makes a huge difference.
There are professionals who do their job very well, and then there are those who also do it with heart. Thank you for caring for Happy with such love, dedication, and professionalism, and for being so involved in her recovery. Thank you from the bottom of my heart for everything you are doing. I will always recommend you.
Highly recommended veterinary clinic. The staff is friendly and welcoming; you can tell they genuinely love animals and treat them with great care. A very positive experience.

I've been taking my dog ​​Oto to this veterinary clinic for a long time.
Sandra has always taken excellent care of Oto and has been dedicated to finding solutions for his condition, treating him with great care at all times, right up until the moment of his passing. She carried him out with all the love and care in the world, and he passed away peacefully. Thank you, Sandra.

If you have pets, I highly recommend the Finca Roja veterinary clinic. Sandra is an excellent professional and person, as is her team, Iris and Mari. Thank you.

And Sandra, Oto thanks you too.

Vicente Collado
They treated Milo wonderfully from the very first moment. Very attentive, friendly, and professional. You can tell they care about animals 🫂🫂🫂🫂 …

Wonderful professionals. I'm delighted with the care they give my cat Mollo. He recently had eye surgery and everything went perfectly thanks to this team.
I highly recommend this center. A perfect ten!

I wouldn't trade this place for anything. Sandra is a wonderful veterinarian who's always there when we need her. The rest of the team is lovely, super attentive and caring on every visit. My dogs are in very good hands, and I'm completely at ease. Gusete and Lowi thank you!!

Fantastic care from the whole team. They looked after Parker at all times and performed all the necessary tests to rule out any problems. They even saw him outside of regular hours, which shows how much they care and go out of their way to help their patients. In short, they are incredibly attentive, kind, and make our dog comfortable at all times. Thank you so much! 🥰🐾
Sandra and her team are excellent. My dog ​​Maya is in good hands.

I went for the first time, an emergency, with my cat. They saw her right away that same morning and ran a battery of tests, which put my mind at ease. She'll definitely be my cats' new vet, and the whole team was so kind and professional! ❤️

We couldn't be more grateful to Sandra and her team. We've been treating our cats with them for years, and they couldn't be more professional. We recently had to euthanize one of them due to a tumor that couldn't be cured with chemotherapy. They helped us every step of the way, right up to the end, and gave us all the support we needed when we needed it most. Professional and empathetic—you couldn't ask for more. We will never forget it. THANK YOU
Veterinary clinic with a professional team and excellent service. Highly recommended!
She's very professional and excellent at what she does. I can share my experience: my dog ​​had a laparoscopic spay, and both she and I are thrilled. I recommend her 100%.

I've been coming to this vet with my two cats for many years and have always received excellent care. They are professional, caring with animals, and very clear in explaining everything. I highly recommend them! 😊😽😻 …
Very professional and friendly service! I came with my cat and the diagnosis, consultation, and follow-up were all impeccable! I highly recommend them!

We had an emergency with our dog while passing through Valencia, and after explaining the problem, they attended to us very quickly and efficiently.
We noticed the care and genuine interest they show in their clients and pets.
Therefore, we want to acknowledge their excellent service.
Excellent service, attention, and information. I had to leave Spain with my pet, and Luis supported me throughout the entire process, literally until I landed. Highly recommended 5/5

I've been taking my furry friends to this groomer for years, and they always look gorgeous and spotless. Plus, Mari is a sweetheart, and her service is top-notch; you can tell she treats them with so much love. They always come home happy. Without a doubt, this is our go-to groomer.
The service was super fast, super attentive, and super professional. Thank you so much! ☺️
Excellent service
Highly recommended veterinary clinic and grooming salon. A very professional and friendly team, always looking out for the animals' well-being.

This is the best veterinary clinic in Valencia. My dog ​​Mayla adores Dr. Sandra and her team. Sandra is a true professional! She detected Mayla's peritonitis in time and saved her life 🙏. Even after the operation, Mayla runs to the clinic with joy. 🐶🤗🤩😊 Thank you all 🌼🌼🌼 …

Super professional and the service was unbeatable. My Benito couldn't be in better hands! Thanks to their quick action and the tests they performed, everything went perfectly, especially considering his age, and his recovery is going wonderfully.

The best vet I've ever been to. Excellent service and they always explain everything very clearly so you can take care of your furry friend. I recommend them 100% because they do their job and give advice perfectly.

Very friendly service.
The dog is delighted to come.
Highly recommended! They're excellent professionals and very friendly. I highly recommend them! 🤗 …
It's the best place I could have taken my dog, thank you all so much ❤️
Highly recommended!!! Professional and caring service. They really care about our pets. Thanks to them, I have a healthy puppy. 🩷 …
Mari does a great job grooming my Spanish Water Dog, plus she's a lovely girl and very affectionate.
Excellent service and great care for the animals.

An unparalleled experience! I took my dog ​​Draco in because he needed his leg checked out.
My Draco loves jumping on the sofa and running around the park, but from one day to the next he started limping badly and didn't want to walk. He stopped doing what he loved so much.

But thanks to Sandra and her team, I've been able to see my Draco happy again.
After surgery to fix his knee and rehabilitation, we saw a huge improvement, and he's back to his old self.
Thank you for giving me back my Draco!
They treated my friend in the photo wonderfully. And they're very kind to first-time parents. We're very reassured about our dog's health thanks to them. A perfect 10!
This dog grooming service is excellent; they did a great scissor cut on a Bichon Maltese, and the quality-price ratio is top-notch. The groomer was very gentle with the dog.
Excellent service and outstanding care from the doctor and staff!
A very good veterinarian, and her assistants are also very good.
Excellent service and professionalism.
Highly professional and fully equipped clinic for the complete care of animals. Excellent service and professionalism. Highly recommended.
Excellent service to both people and, of course, our animals. Very professional. Keep up the good work!

Very professional and friendly with the animals.
They care and try to resolve any issues as best they can. Highly recommended.
They were very attentive, they know how to handle my cat, and I won't hesitate to return. I also buy his cat food there—a good brand, not the cheap stuff from Consum. Very professional and reliable.

Overall fine, but when it comes to kidney-related diseases, I highly recommend visiting other vets.

The comment below is my response to the owner's response:

The review is more than fair and offers us no relief because nothing we say will bring our cat back. It's clear you made a mistake, and your error caused Missy to undergo an unnecessary operation, dramatically shortening her life. To begin with, you didn't ask our permission to operate on Missy. The operation was to remove an ectopic ovary laparoscopically, and you ended up operating without our prior consent because, according to you, you weren't sure about it. We had chosen laparoscopy precisely because we wanted the least invasive procedure possible.

You were the ones who diagnosed her with a tumor in the ureter and told us that the kidney attached to that ureter was beyond repair. You told us it was best to remove the ureter because if it was cancer, it could spread to other parts of the body, and if we didn't remove the kidney then, we'd have to come back in two weeks to have it removed. You told us not to worry, that just like people, cats can live with only one kidney. According to your report, the other kidney looked normal. However, the biopsy showed that it wasn't a tumor but fibrosis, and that the kidney you removed was the one that was still functioning. Missy had a kidney problem that you never noticed with the ultrasounds and blood tests you performed. And stop saying that you couldn't find out what was in the ureter without a biopsy because it's possible to find out with urine tests, blood tests, and X-rays.

Despite the fact that the hospital told us Missy's condition was not good and had advised us to consider euthanasia, you told us she seemed fine and that everything would depend on whether her remaining kidney could perform the function of the one you had removed. You gave us hope when there was none because you didn't want to, and still don't want to, admit your mistake. You only told us Missy was terminally ill at the very last minute, days before she died.

We find it unbelievable that you still have the audacity to say you followed all the protocols and that you offered to hospitalize Missy on several occasions. You only offered to hospitalize her once, and I quote: "The medication you are giving her helps to maintain her condition, but to stabilize her, she would need to be hospitalized. This hospitalization is a temporary solution since, unfortunately, her illness cannot be reversed." That means that once the IV drips are removed, it's likely that in a few days he'll return to the same state he's in today. Do you think your suggestion needed a response?

You haven't been clear in your diagnosis, as demonstrated by your reports and text messages. We're giving you one star for your attention, which we agree with in your response.

Hello! We have no record of you having visited our facilities. However, if you specify which service you are reviewing and the reason for your review, we can assess our quality and identify areas for improvement. Regards.

Amazing service and grooming.
The girl is very kind and our dog looks gorgeous; we'll be back every month.

I'm very happy with this veterinary clinic. After visiting on more than one occasion, the treatment I and my two cats have received from the professionals has been exceptional. A veterinary clinic with excellent professionals.
Everything was great...thanks
A very good professional, Mina and Pepa are very well looked after and always treated with affection by all the staff.

The experience wasn't good; I wouldn't recommend it.

(Edit) I don't know who Triana is, but I feel sorry for her too. Although they'll probably delete the reply.
Kindness, attentiveness, and professionalism. I just took a puppy in, and I've only been three times, but both the veterinary care and the grooming have been excellent.

Hi! I used to take my kittens to another vet, but I wasn't happy there, and my little kitten kept vomiting. I needed a change... then I found Sandra's veterinary clinic, and I'm so happy! My little Siri is already eating well, growing, and very playful. I'm so grateful; they are attentive and lovely.
Amazing friendly staff that speak English!
I take my dog ​​Mati to the groomer with Mari and I couldn't be happier. Mari is super affectionate and very patient, and Mati always comes out looking perfect!

Excellent service and empathy from the owners.
Everything was perfect.

The service was excellent, and I went there a second time. I hadn't been able to schedule an appointment before, but I had a temporary break yesterday and asked if I could schedule one for today. Is that really possible?
Everything was great, they were always very attentive and efficient!

I came from Alfafar because my kitten was very sick, with a bad liver. After a long stay at another vet, he wasn't improving, and I was expecting the worst, until I met Sandra and Iris. Super Michi has improved so much! They are definitely fantastic vets! Thank you for taking such good care of my little one.
We are so happy and grateful for how they treat and care for our dog! You can tell they do it with so much love!

Excellent veterinary clinic with a highly professional and friendly team. They always treat my pets with great care and dedication. It's a very welcoming and clean clinic, which gives me peace of mind and confidence. I would 100% recommend this clinic to any pet owner looking for a trustworthy place and exceptional service.

I've been bringing Cova to Sandra since she was a puppy, and we're very happy. The service is excellent and very professional. Sandra and her team treat the animals with great care and gentleness. Highly recommended!
